title: Unable to insert list of dictionaries into an array<struct<string>> column in Databricks Delta table
question:
I have a delta table in Databricks that has the below definition:

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE emp_db.employee_details
(
    employee_id BIGINT,
    employee_name STRING,
    emp_deptname STRING,
    emp_endpoint STRING,
    emp_folder STRING,
    emp_address ARRAY<STRUCT<type STRING, city STRING, 
                             apartment_number STRING, pincode STRING>>,
    event_timestamp STRING
) 
USING delta TBLPROPERTIES (delta.enableChangeDataFeed = true, delta.feature.allowColumnDefaults = 'supported');

The column emp_address is clearly defined with the required schema as shown in the below screenshot of the DESCRIBE statement.

But when I try to perform the below INSERT INTO statement, it throws an error

Syntax error at or near '['. SQLSTATE: 42601

INSERT INTO emp_db.employee_details(employee_id, employee_name, emp_deptname, emp_endpoint, emp_folder, emp_address, event_timestamp)
VALUES (
    873547690, 'abc', 'sales', 'abc@abc01storage', 'messages', [{"type":"Home","city":"Delhi","apartment_number":"H.Number 124, B block, XYZ Towers","pincode":"123abc"},{"type":"Postbox","city":"Delhi","apartment_number":"Post Office 12A, Sector 22","pincode":"456xyz"}], '2025-07-16 13:10:43')

Not sure what I am doing wrong.

Can someone please help?
answer:
I used array(named_struct(), named_struct()) notation in the INSERT statement to load the data. It worked:

INSERT INTO emp_db.employee_details(employee_id, employee_name, emp_deptname, emp_endpoint, emp_folder, emp_address, event_timestamp)
    VALUES (
    873547690, 'abc', 'sales', 'abc@abc01storage', 'messages', array(named_struct('type', 'Home', 'city', 'Delhi', 'apartment_number', 'H.Number 124, B block, XYZ Towers', 'pincode', '123abc'), named_struct('type', 'Postbox', 'city', 'Delhi', 'apartment_number', 'Post Office 12A, Sector 22', 'pincode', '456xyz')), '2025-07-16 13:10:43')
